biography.value: Void Gnashers are blunt instruments — large, durable, capable of Grappling targets and then applying Reality Crush or Swallow Whole to remove them from the encounter entirely. Their intelligence is below the threshold for complex instruction-following. A summoner who gives one a simple, concrete direction ("grapple that target, do not release it") will find it executes that instruction reliably. One who gives complex conditional instructions will find the Gnasher defaulting to its base imperatives, which is to find something to bite. For the specific function of taking a single high-priority target out of an encounter for several rounds, it is unusually effective at its tier. The force damage on Gnashing Maw ignoring DR means armor provides limited protection.

system.attacksNotes:
Gnashing Maw [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str) + 3 force damage (Ignore DR); target is Grappled if they are Medium or smaller.
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 force damage; Grappled; target takes 6 damage at the start of each of their turns while Grappled; target Disoriented while Grappled.
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 force damage; Target is Pinned and suffers 6 damage at the start of each of their turns while Pinned or Grappled; target Disoriented while Pinned or Grappled.

Reality Crush [Combat]: May only target a Grappled or Pinned creature:

  • Margin 1:: 14 force damage (Ignore DR); target's Fortitude [Easy] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 2: 14 force damage, DR halved (round up); Fortitude [Hard] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.; Fortitude [Easy] save or Weakened for 1 minute.
  • Margin 3: 14 force damage, DR halved (round up); Fortitude [Hard] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.; Fortitude [Hard] save or Weakened for 1 minute. Fortitude [Hard] save or takes 20 points of damage to their maximum HP.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Aberrant Resilience: The Void Gnasher's body does not respond to pain or physical trauma in any predictable way. It does not gain the Hindered condition from standard pain-based effects. Effects that specifically say "creatures immune to pain" function normally against it. Swallow Whole (1/encounter): If the Void Gnasher has a target Grappled and reduced to below half their maximum HP, it can attempt to Swallow them as a [Combat] action. The target makes a Fortitude [Easy] save. On failure, they are Swallowed: they take 6 force damage (Ignore DR) at the start of each of their turns, are Blinded and Immobilized. Swallowed creatures are expelled if the Gnasher dies. Resilient Defense (1/day): When the Void Gnasher fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
